## Exact location

Please give the file path, section/lemma/constraint, and commit SHA if relevant.

## Suspected problem

State the first implication you believe is invalid as precisely as possible.

## Smallest counterexample or witness

If possible, provide the smallest graph/configuration/parameter tuple that exposes the issue, or enough information to reproduce it.

## Consequence

Does this appear to affect:

- [ ] only a redundant verification route;
- [ ] a proof-critical lemma;
- [ ] a fixed-order headline candidate;
- [ ] a general structural candidate;
- [ ] unclear.

## Supporting computation or references

Please include code, exact arithmetic, literature references, or other evidence if available.
